subject: Private/VPC: legal/dataflow checklist and evidence roadmap
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: MediNova Security <security@medinova.com>
Date: 2028-03-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private/VPC: legal/dataflow checklist and evidence roadmap

Hi Jason —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the items we agreed to surface so your security and legal teams can start their review: 

1) Compliance posture (high level)
   - Please confirm current SOC 2 Type II status and attach your most recent summary report (we typically ask for the SOC 2 summary + any bridge letters).
   - Indicate whether HIPAA applies to the workloads you plan to run in the Private deployment and whether there are any specific BAAs in flight.

2) Data residency & processing
   - You mentioned EU-only tenancy for PHI-adjacent logs. Confirm which datasets are in-scope (e.g., full text, derived telemetry, logs).

3) Network/topology evidence
   - A single-page network diagram (PNG/PDF) showing VPC segmentation, peering, NAT/gateway points, and any on-prem VPNs. If you have an air-gapped variant, please include that as a second diagram.

4) Vendor questionnaire / RFI initiation
   - I’ve attached a short vendor RFI we ask customers to complete for Private deployments. If it’s easier, send your security contact the answers and the supporting docs and we’ll pick up from there.

Attach: vendor_rfi_template.xlsx (see list below)

Next steps from our side: I’ll loop in our Security Ops and Legal to identify any additional evidence we’ll need for a scoped Private/VPC review. Can you aim to send the SOC summary + network diagram by EOD Wednesday (2028-03-31)? If that timeline is tight, let me know and we’ll adjust.

Thanks —
Olga

Thanks Olga — quick read below and recommended next steps.

Summary assessment (high level):
- SOC2: Summary looks standard; we'll request the full report under NDA (SOC2 Type II report + any relevant bridge letters).
- HIPAA: Because they process PHI, we will require an executed BAA prior to production access. Ask Legal to start the BAA thread; I can provide our standard BAA template.
- EU residency: We can support EU-only processing for model inputs/storage on Private deployments (pin to EU region). We need clarity on which logs may replicate to US and whether those logs include PHI.
- Network: The supplied diagram is acceptable as a starting point for non-airgap. For PHI-in-scope customers we strongly prefer either (a) VPC-only peering without replication to public logs, or (b) an air-gapped variant.

Immediate evidence requests (send these to security@medinova.com):
- SOC2 Type II report (under NDA)
- Signed or draft BAA
- KMS ownership and key custody details (who holds keys; if customer-managed, provide KMS ARN)
- Network ACLs / SG exports and routing table snippets showing peering config
- Flow logs / sample logs with PHI redaction examples (if logs replicate to US)
- Hardening/config checklist for the host image and any software we would install

Attachments I’m including for their convenience:
- redwood_evidence_template.docx (evidence template we prefer customers to return)
- airgap-checklist.md (practical checklist for air-gapped deployments)

Proposed next steps:
1) Olga to request full SOC2 under NDA and their completed evidence template (use the drive link below).
2) Jason / MediNova to confirm whether logs will contain PHI when replicated outside EU. If yes, air-gap or additional controls required.
3) If MediNova wants an air-gapped path, schedule a 30-min technical call (I’m available Tue/Wed next week 09:00-11:00 PT).
